выйти.gloss: to go out, to get out

выходить.gloss: to go out, to get out

meanings.en: to go out, to come out

examples.trans: You give me five hundred roubles, and I get out and buy you the best console in the world.

meanings.note: Contrast дома = at home. Core Russian adv meaning '(to) home, homeward' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Так, мы идём к слепым. А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: Right, we're going to the blind people. And you go home and do your homework.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('living, alive, live').

examples.trans: Cutting a living person with a knife!

examples.text: Нина, ну как ты могла? Живого человека ножом резать!
examples.trans: Nina, how could you? Cutting a living person with a knife!

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'ткнуться'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to shut up'. The reflexive suffix '-ся'/'-сь' makes the action intransitive, reciprocal, or directed at the subject.

examples.text: Заткнись, Вика, я никогда не делаю ошибок!
examples.trans: Shut up, Vika, I never make mistakes!

examples.text: Заткнись, рыжая, не мешай мне спокойно работать!
examples.trans: Shut up, redhead, do not disturb me working peacefully!

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я уже знаю. Мне звонили из мэрии.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, I already know. The town hall called me.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'даваться'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to give up, to surrender', paired with 'сдаться'.

examples.text: Никогда не сдавайся! Сегодня я выйду отсюда под подписку!
examples.trans: Never give up! Today I'm getting out of here on a travel ban!
